name: SprintOps
description: SprintOps is an agile project and task management tool for teams. Plan sprints, manage backlogs, organize work on Kanban boards, and track progress with reports like burndown and velocity. Collaborate with assignments, comments, and notifications to keep deliveries on schedule.

events.d: Create a new task in a sprint or the backlog, including title, description, assignees, priority, status, type, and story points.

events.n: When a new task is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new task is created in SprintOps.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a task is updated in SprintOps.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a task is moved in SprintOps.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a task is assigned.

events.n: When a task's sprint assignment changes
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a task is assigned to, moved between, or removed from a sprint.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever any task is deleted.
